title: Uncovering Political Bias in Large Language Models using Parliamentary Voting Records

bias_targets.methodology: Prompting models to vote 'for' or 'against' real parliamentary motions and comparing their decisions to the voting records of established political parties to project their ideological positions into a shared two-dimensional space.
Counterfactually substituting the names of different political parties into the prompt to measure how attributing a motion to a specific party systematically shifts the model's voting predictions.
